Organisms are born, grow older, reproduce, and die.
Some organisms lay eggs. Their offspring hatch out of the eggs. Reptiles, birds, and insects are examples of animals that lay eggs.
Other organisms give birth to live offspring. Bears, dogs, and people are examples of animals that give birth to live offspring.

contents.text: All organisms grow and die.
Frogs lay eggs, and so do sea turtles. They do not give birth to live young.
Sea turtles do not go through metamorphosis. Young sea turtles grow up to be adult sea turtles.

Frogs go through metamorphosis. They completely change shape during their lives. Frogs hatch out of eggs as swimming tadpoles. Then, the tadpoles lose their tails and grow legs. Finally, the adult frogs crawl onto land.
